snippet.title: Spindle - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Dig into adventure with your pig companion when Spindle releases October 13th on PC and Nintendo Switch 💀🐷🖤

SPINDLE is an old-school action-adventure about death and the many ways we choose to deal with it. With your trusty Pig by your side, you form a most curious team, embarking on a quest to learn what it truly means to be Death. 

Steam: https://s.team/a/1386750
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/spindle
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/spindlegame.bsky.social
Twitter: https://twitter.com/spindledev
